_comment: WPT Tier-1 seed manifest — Phase 0.5 W0a (trench/forensics/2026-07-15-wpt-phase05-GATE-OPEN.md §4).
This file is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for which WPT tests HiWave imports. third_party/wpt/ is a
gitignored working copy produced by scripts/wpt_sync.sh from this list — never the other way round.
No pass-rate is published from this file alone. W0a ships the list; W0b ships the runner and the
first honest K/N. Anyone quoting a 'WPT %' before trench/wpt/last-run.json exists is quoting nothing.
pin_policy: Frozen for the campaign. Re-pin only at a campaign boundary, deliberately, both seats in lockstep — same discipline as the CfT-148 pin (PLAN.md).

path_verification.method: Every path below was read verbatim out of a directory listing of the WPT tree AT THE PINNED SHA (GitHub contents API, ref=<wpt_pin>). Nothing here is recalled or guessed.
path_verification.not_verified: The test->ref BINDING is not verified. WPT's authority for a reference is the test file's own <link rel=match href=...>, which requires reading each test. The `ref` field below is the same-directory candidate seen in the listing; W0b's runner MUST read rel=match from the test and treat a disagreement with this field as an instrument error, not a render diff.
path_verification.seat_limitation: This seat cannot clone or curl (git ls-remote / curl / git clone are all off the Bash allowlist), so scripts/wpt_sync.sh below has NEVER BEEN RUN. It ships un-dry-run. See README.md §Known gaps.
